title: Bank reconciliation CSV import
summary: CSV/OFX import and statement matching; the module structure exists but does not do import or matching
notes: Done 2026-11-14: full item. lib/reconcile.py (pure core: parse_csv_statement under a declared mapping, parse_ofx_statement for OFX 1.x SGML + 2.x XML via stdlib only, match_lines, dedup_key) + modules/account.py (pair account import/match, ACCOUNT_OPTIONS + dispatch, one read-only summary line wired into cmd_reconcile). Design: statement lines in YAML store statements/<slug>.yaml (one file per account, slug = slugified account path), {account, imports:[{file, sha256, imported_at, lines}], lines:[{date, description, amount, fitid, source_file, matched, status}]}. Import stores lines only, never writes to the journal. Idempotency two layers: file sha256 recorded (re-import is a no-op) + line dedup key (account, date, amount, description, fitid-or-empty) skips lines already stored; known limit: two genuinely identical same-day CSV purchases with byte-identical descriptions share a key and dedup to one. CSV mapping DECLARED, never guessed: named mapping in config.yaml statement_mappings: (--mapping NAME) or --col-date/--col-desc/--col-amount (or --col-debit/--col-credit) flags; date_format declared (default %Y-%m-%d); missing column fails with a clear message, nothing written. Matching rules: amount exact to the cent + dates within window (default +/-3 days, --window flag); one candidate -> matched; several -> uniquely closest date wins, tie on distance is ambiguous; none -> unmatched; re-running match only touches still-unmatched lines. cmd_reconcile unchanged except one read-only summary line when a store exists. CLI only — no web endpoints (not in the item as written). Auto-booking unmatched lines deliberately NOT built (trust step for the owner). Tests: tests/test_reconcile.py (23 tests: CSV incl. quoted commas/paren negatives/debit-credit/date formats, OFX SGML + XML, matcher exact/window/near-miss/ambiguous/unique-closest, import incl. idempotency + OFX, match counts 2/1/3, match stability, reconcile unchanged + summary) + fixtures tests/fixtures/statement.csv + statement.ofx. Suite 579 -> 602 green.

title: Reject newlines in journal entry fields
summary: format_entry/format_commodity_entry/serialize_entry interpolated description/account/tag values verbatim, so a newline smuggled extra postings or a whole second transaction into the journal; validate_entry does not catch amount-less forged postings (hledger infers and balances). require_single_line in lib/journal.py rejects CR/LF in every interpolated value; web handlers return 400 and write nothing
notes: Fixed 2026-11-13: require_single_line in lib/journal.py, applied in lib/entry.py serialize_entry; raw mode in /api/entry/advanced left alone by design; tests in tests/test_security_holes.py

title: Harden raw mode: date-consistency check + record decision D19
summary: Raw text was written as-is but record_entry files by the date field while hledger reads the date from the text, so a 2022-dated entry typed today landed in generated/2026/entries.journal yet counted as 2022. Write path now rejects any raw transaction date differing from the entry date; D19 records the keep-hardened decision.
